## Site
Name: PromoGrind

Owner: VaultSpark Studios LLC
Contact: hello@promogrind.bet

## What this site is
PromoGrind is a free, browser-based toolkit for sportsbook promo conversion math.
It provides 53 calculators covering matched betting, arbitrage, expected value (+EV),
promo conversion, parlay building, Kelly criterion bankroll sizing, and more.

This is an educational math tool — equivalent to a mortgage or tax calculator. It
performs calculations on numbers the user inputs. It does not place bets, access
sportsbook accounts, or handle money of any kind.

## Audience
Sports bettors and matched bettors seeking to maximize returns from sportsbook
promotional offers in US states and jurisdictions where sports betting is legal.

## Legal
- Users must be 21+ (18+ in some states)
- Available only in jurisdictions where sports betting is legal
- All gambling winnings are taxable income
- If you or someone you know has a gambling problem: 1-800-GAMBLER

## Monetization
PromoGrind is free to use. It earns revenue through affiliate referral links
to sportsbooks (DraftKings, FanDuel, Caesars, ESPN BET, Fanatics). A Pro
subscription ($9.99/month) unlocks AI-powered features and live scanning tools.
